workarounds.symptom: [BUG] TypeScript SDK client.compress retries and swallows typed 4xx errors from the proxy
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(sdk): throw typed proxy 4xx errors from compress instead of retrying. Target files: sdk/typescript/src/client.ts, sdk/typescript/src/errors.ts, sdk/typescript/test/client.test.ts. `HeadroomClient.compress` only stopped retrying on a `HeadroomCompressError` below 500. When the proxy's error body has a typed `error.type`, `mapProxyError` returns `ConfigurationError`, `ValidationError` and so on, so those 4xx responses were retried and, with the default `fallback: true`, turned into an uncompressed result. The call... (Ref: https://github.com/headroomlabs-ai/headroom/pull/4751)

workarounds.symptom: [BUG] headroom-oauth2: a misconfigured install() is skipped by the extension loader, so the proxy starts without the middleware although SPEC.md says it fails closed
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(proxy): let an extension declare its install() fail-closed (#4737). Target files: headroom/proxy/extensions.py, headroom/proxy/server.py, plugins/headroom-oauth2/pyproject.toml. `plugins/headroom-oauth2/SPEC.md:67` promised that a missing or invalid config at startup makes `install()` raise and the proxy **fail closed** ("won't start mis-auth'd"), and its `CHANGELOG.md:25` said "Fails closed on misconfiguration". (Ref: https://github.com/headroomlabs-ai/headroom/pull/4773)

workarounds.symptom: [BUG] TypeScript SDK Gemini adapter drops thoughtSignature, functionCall.id and the thought flag when it sends compressed contents
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(sdk): keep Gemini thought signatures and call ids through the compress round trip. Target files: sdk/typescript/src/utils/format.ts, sdk/typescript/test/adapters/gemini.test.ts, sdk/typescript/test/utils/format.test.ts. The TypeScript Gemini adapter lost three part fields on every compressed request: `thought`, `thoughtSignature`, and the provider-assigned `functionCall.id` / `functionResponse.id`. Gemini 3 answers a function-call turn whose first `functionCall` lost its `thoughtSignature` with a `400 INVALID_AR... (Ref: https://github.com/headroomlabs-ai/headroom/pull/4777)

workarounds.symptom: [BUG] TypeScript SDK client.telemetry.getTool puts the signature hash in the URL path without encoding it
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(sdk): encode the signature hash in client.telemetry.getTool. Target files: sdk/typescript/src/client.ts, sdk/typescript/test/client-expanded.test.ts. `client.telemetry.getTool(signatureHash)` in `sdk/typescript/src/client.ts` (line 461 on `200c838c`) put its argument into the URL path unencoded. The `feedback` method (line 473) and the `toin` method (line 489) in the same file wrap theirs in `encodeURIComponent`. A value containing `/`, `?` or `#` changed which route was requested; for example `"../../v1/feedbac... (Ref: https://github.com/headroomlabs-ai/headroom/pull/4772)

workarounds.symptom: [BUG] TypeScript SDK pluginConfigDir/pluginWorkspaceDir accept "." and ".." and NUL (the Python twin rejects them)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(sdk): reject "." ".." and NUL plugin names like the python twin. Target files: sdk/typescript/src/paths.ts, sdk/typescript/test/paths.test.ts. `assertPluginName` in `sdk/typescript/src/paths.ts` (line 250 on `200c838c`) rejected only an empty name, `/` and `\`. `pluginConfigDir(".")` returned a path ending in `plugins/.`, `pluginConfigDir("..")` one ending in `plugins/..` (which resolves to the config directory), `pluginWorkspaceDir("..")` the same under the workspace root, and a name containing NUL was accepted... (Ref: https://github.com/headroomlabs-ai/headroom/pull/4771)

workarounds.symptom: [BUG] e2e/wrap npm-audit-exceptions.json says no newer npm exists, but npm 12.2.2 is published and drops 6 of the 8 exceptions (the gate expires 2026-11-15)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(deps): move the wrap E2E harness to npm 12.2.2 and drop the fixed audit exceptions. Target files: e2e/wrap/tools/package.json, e2e/wrap/Dockerfile, e2e/wrap/tools/dependency-regression.test.cjs. `e2e/wrap/tools/npm-audit-exceptions.json` excepted 8 advisories in npm 12.2.1's bundled copies and gave "no newer npm release is available" as part of the reason. npm 12.2.2 is published and bundles cleanness for 6 of those 8: undici 6.29.0 → 6.29.1 and ip-address 10.7.2 → 10.7.5. Moving the harness pin drops those exce... (Ref: https://github.com/headroomlabs-ai/headroom/pull/4778)

workarounds.symptom: [BUG] Subscription `toin_read_only` policy is not honoured on two TOIN write paths (router -> SmartCrusher.crush, and Kompress CCR store)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(transforms): honour Subscription toin_read_only when the router calls SmartCrusher. Target files: headroom/transforms/content_router.py, headroom/transforms/smart_crusher.py, tests/test_compression_policy_toin_gate.py. Subscription requests still wrote observations to the shared TOIN store when the `ContentRouter` compressed a JSON array with SmartCrusher. `CompressionPolicy.toin_read_only` says Subscription traffic must never write to TOIN (`compression_policy.py`). (Ref: https://github.com/headroomlabs-ai/headroom/pull/4493)
